text_block_list.text:
It's the last day of summer camp. I'm just
finishing
up training with Нарита Брайан.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Okay. Let me get a drink of water first.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: You seem to be exerting yourself, Brian.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
You look as strong as ever. What do you
think?
Shall we race each other?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
If I'm going to race you, I'd rather do it
in a G1
than a place like this.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Let's settle this in a formal setting where
we can
bring out each other's max
potential. I want to
give it everything
I've got.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
...You're probably right. You regard me
as a
worthy opponent.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Since that's the case, I'll respect your
wishes.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Get stronger, Brian. I see a bright future
in you.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
The last day of summer camp comes to
an end
under the watchful eye of
Симболи Рудольф.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
